decisions.decision: Separate global Circle Agent Stack/x402 USDC share from Arc-chain-specific x402 activity.
decisions.reason: Circle's 98.8% statement describes global agent-driven transaction volume, not Arc-only volume.

decisions.decision: Track Arc public-chain metrics and filtered organic activity separately.
decisions.reason: Bitquery's first-month study found 94% active-wallet decline, farms, bots and a self-trading outlier; headline DEX volume overstated adjusted real-trader volume.

decisions.decision: Track Arc stablecoin supply, TVL, DEX, perps, active addresses, bridge flows and Morpho credit as separate time series.
decisions.reason: DefiLlama's Nov 1 data show material TVL, stablecoin and perps activity despite weaker early organic-wallet retention.

decisions.decision: Compare Arc cirBTC/USDC and Base cbXRP/USDC Morpho markets as separate collateral markets.
decisions.reason: USDC is a shared debt asset; collateral, LLTV, borrower, vault and bridge-flow dimensions differ.

decisions.decision: Represent SBI Group as a multi-rail investor/operator: Ripple equity, Circle equity, ARC presale, Arc validator, USDC distribution, RLUSD MOU and XRP remittance.
decisions.reason: SBI's direct capital and operating relationships span both ecosystems; SBIC is a separate entity.

decisions.decision: Do not infer XRP token holdings from SBI's 9% Ripple equity stake.
decisions.reason: SBI's official investor presentation identifies equity ownership, not a $10B XRP token position.

forecast_policy: No directional XRP forecast until Arc and XRPL data are normalized, bot/cluster adjusted, time-aligned and tested out of sample.
